metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from tinkerbench-studio. Each plugin lives in its own repository; this lists them under one name.

plugins.name: tick-it
plugins.description: Tick-it tickets in the session, from the Tick-it MCP server: a board, the ticket's brief for Claude, a size budget on edits, and review agents that steward it to Done.

plugins.name: drawing-board
plugins.description: Design workflows for any project with a design canvas and Storybook: designing on a prototype page first, keeping the canvas, its committed snapshot and Storybook in step, flow-based canvas pages, and the board-beside-story picture a UX change carries.

plugins.name: vibesec
plugins.description: VibeSec-Skill, a general secure-web-application skill: Claude applies it when writing web code or when asked to scan or audit it. Not specific to Tick-it or the design canvas.
